name: servo-mcp
description: A ChatGPT MCP App that runs Servo WASM as an isolated, headless browser with web search.

scripts.dev: npm run engine:fetch && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run engine:fetch && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run engine:fetch && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --dry-run
